title: Range Sum of BST
description: Given the root node of a binary search tree and two integers low and high, return the sum of values of all nodes with a value in the inclusive range [low, high].

steps.note: Root 10 is within [7, 15]. Add 10 to sum and traverse left.
Node 5 is less than low (7). Prune left branch, go right.
Node 15 is within [7, 15]. Add 15 to sum.
Node 18 is greater than high (15). Prune right branch.
